dimensions.UEB: Other deposits on sight in CHF
dimensions.TG: Total sight deposits in CHF at the SNB

2022-23 SNB FX selling.note: largest move in the whole series; correct NEGATIVE sign

contamination.cause: Credit Suisse emergency liquidity, NOT FX intervention
contamination.detail: GI +40.5bn and UEB +11.3bn both jump, so neither sub-series isolates FX operations

known_failure_modes: 87.8% of CSV rows are EMPTY daily calendar scaffold -- a naive read+ffill manufactures a daily series that does not exist
PublishingDate is a portal-wide RELEASE stamp shared across cubes (snbgwdmigirow and snbgwdzid carry the identical value), not a per-observation stamp

publication lag measured ONCE (n=1): Friday data published Monday 10:00 CET = 3 calendar days. Consume the Friday observation from Monday 10:00 CET at the earliest; indexing it on its own Friday stamp grants hindsight
TG and UEB start 2011-08-19 but GI starts 2009-01-09 -- the sub-series have DIFFERENT histories and a joined frame silently truncates to 2011
domestic emergency-liquidity operations enter the same series as FX intervention (2023 Credit Suisse)
